pairs.claim: The REM's permanent artworks are valued at $7.3 million, and temporary works are being created in collaboration with four Montreal universities.
A separate $5 million budget funds the temporary artworks created by university students.
In fall 2024, two permanent artworks were inaugurated at the Brossard and Panama stations.
In February 2025, CDPQ Infra revealed the names of the artists creating public artworks for five new REM stations.
